# -static sets the static, netgo, and osusergo build tags on every
# system that supports it, not only on Linux.

env GOARCH=amd64
env CGO_ENABLED=0

env GOOS=linux
go list -static -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
stdout '\bstatic\b'
stdout '\bnetgo\b'
stdout '\bosusergo\b'

env GOOS=freebsd
go list -static -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
stdout '\bstatic\b'
stdout '\bnetgo\b'
stdout '\bosusergo\b'

env GOOS=netbsd
go list -static -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
stdout '\bstatic\b'
stdout '\bnetgo\b'
stdout '\bosusergo\b'

env GOOS=dragonfly
go list -static -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
stdout '\bstatic\b'
stdout '\bnetgo\b'
stdout '\bosusergo\b'

env GOOS=plan9
go list -static -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
stdout '\bstatic\b'
stdout '\bnetgo\b'
stdout '\bosusergo\b'

env GOOS=wasip1
env GOARCH=wasm
go list -static -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
stdout '\bstatic\b'
stdout '\bnetgo\b'
stdout '\bosusergo\b'

# The netcgo build tag conflicts with netgo, so netgo is not set with it.
env GOOS=freebsd
env GOARCH=amd64
go list -static -tags netcgo -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
stdout '\bstatic\b'
! stdout '\bnetgo\b'
stdout '\bosusergo\b'

# Without -static, none of the tags are set.
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}' .
! stdout '\bstatic\b'
! stdout '\bnetgo\b'
! stdout '\bosusergo\b'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/static

go 1.22
-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
